steps: 1. In Adventure mode, equip visibly distinct illusions on both your melee and ranged weapons. In **Tweaker: Chaos Wastes**, turn on **Preserve Weapon Illusions from Adventure Loadout** before starting a new expedition.
2. Start the expedition. Confirm each compatible starter weapon uses the illusion from its matching Adventure weapon instead of a random one.
3. Temper one of those weapons at a Weapon Upgrade Altar, including an upgrade to Unique if available. Confirm its current compatible illusion survives.

4. Use weapon-swap chests. A replacement in the same weapon family should keep the saved compatible illusion; a different-family replacement should keep its normal generated appearance. Bot weapons must remain unaffected.
5. Turn the option off and start another expedition. Starter generation, upgrades, and swaps must return to normal vanilla appearance selection.
6. Run `/ct_regression_test`, exit normally, and attach the newest complete log, identifying each starter, upgrade, same-family swap, and different-family control that was available.
assertions: Only the local player's compatible melee/ranged illusions are preserved. Compatible starters, upgrades, and same-family swaps retain them; incompatible families, bots, and toggle-off play remain vanilla. Repeated generation does not leak a slot or weapon family's appearance into another, and the regression report passes.
Equip a known skin in Adventure; start a run with the option on; assert starter item.skin equals it when matching_item_key matches; after upgrade same; off not forced.
